name: Ranged Injection

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: The projectiles in this weapon can be filled with a liquid, usually an injury poison, serum, or spell amp. The damage listed for the weapon is the default substance used for the weapon. Filling a single piece of ammunition with a new substance requires 6 Interact actions and uses two hands. Immediately after a successful attack with the weapon, the target is injected with the loaded contents.
